She combines medical expertise, artistic vision, and individualized treatment planning to help clients achieve their aesthetic goals with confidence. Known for her thoughtful and personalized approach, Chris takes the time to understand each client’s unique goals, anatomy, and preferences before creating a customized treatment plan. Clients appreciate Chris’s attention to detail, artistic eye, and ability to create personalized treatment plans tailored to their unique goals. Why Clients Choose Chris Medical Aesthetics Personalized Care — You’ll work directly with the same experienced injector at every visit, allowing for consistency, continuity, and treatment plans tailored to your goals. Comprehensive Treatments — Botox, dermal fillers, SkinPen microneedling, medical-grade skincare, and advanced hair restoration treatments in Portland, Maine. Advanced Hair Restoration — Chris Medical Aesthetics is proud to offer one of Southern Maine’s few dedicated hair restoration programs, using advanced laser technology to help address hair thinning and hair loss.
